subject: Joint Evaluation Checklist & Deployment Governance — NovaHealth MAP
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@novahealth.co.uk>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Gavin Price <gavin.price@novahealth.co.uk>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: NovaHealth evaluation — MAP kickoff and constraints

Hi Vanessa / Rishi,

Thanks for taking this on. We've kicked off an internal MAP for Redwood's evaluation at NovaHealth and need to lock down the deployment mode and region guardrails early — our Compliance and Procurement teams both flagged data residency and uptime SLOs as gating items. High-level asks:

- Confirm which Redwood deployment modes (Hosted in EU, Dedicated, Private) meet our data residency and audit requirements.
- Provide a short evaluation checklist we can map to our procurement milestones.
- Proposed close window: end of March (we have an internal procurement review on 2026-03-22).

Can you share a MAP doc (even draft) and any security artifacts we should attach to our packet? Also send a strawman timeline for pilot -> contract signature.

Best,
Emma
Emma Clarke
Head of Digital Transformation, NovaHealth
emma.clarke@novahealth.co.uk

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@novahealth.co.uk>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: RE: NovaHealth evaluation — MAP kickoff and constraints

Hi Emma — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the clear asks. Attached: 1) NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP + tasks), 2) security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (initial responses).

Quick summary of what we've put in the draft MAP:
- Decision points: Data residency (EU region), Deployment mode (Hosted-eu, Dedicated-reserved, Private-premise)
- Evaluation tasks: security review, perf benchmark (1k concurrent requests), failover/fallback test, cost estimate per-month, integration checklist
- Owners & dates: we propose a two-week evaluation window, pilot in eu-west, contract signature target the week of 2026-03-15 -> 2026-03-22.

Action items for NovaHealth (from the checklist):
- Confirm required region(s) and whether UK-only residency is required (Legal)
- Complete outstanding fields in the security questionnaire (we've marked the ones we filled)
- Approve pilot scope (models, RPS targets, telemetry retention)

Vanessa notes on deployment guidance:
- Hosted (EU region): fastest to start, Redwood-hosted data plane in eu-west; good for low onboarding friction if NovaHealth accepts our EU-hosted controls.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput, stronger isolation — recommended if you want guaranteed baseline throughput and easier SLA guarantees.
- Private: full customer-managed network, longest lead-time (procurement + infra), recommended for regulated/data residency scenarios that require customer-controlled network and HSM/KMS.

I'll need a quick call to walk through the MAP — are you available tomorrow 10:00–11:00 CET?

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+44 20 5555 0123

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP), security_questionnaire_filled.pdf

Thanks Vanessa — reviewed the MAP draft. Two clarifications before we commit to the proposed dates:

1) Cost delta: can you provide a short bullet summary of the expected percent delta between Hosted (eu) and Dedicated for our estimated baseline (monthly 3TB tokens, 10M embeddings)? We can use a high-level number for procurement.
2) Private lead time: what is the typical start-to-pilot lead time (network + infra provisioning + security attestations) if we choose Private? Procurement has asked for a realistic calendar.

Gavin / LegalOps: fyi — we may need Redwood to provide SOC2 evidence + an exportable audit log for initial procurement submission.

Also, on the MAP tasks: we marked the perf benchmarks as critical and pushed them to the front of the evaluation window.

Best,
Emma

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: Internal: NovaHealth pricing + lead-time ask (info for MAP)

Rishi / Karthik — Emma asked for two quick items for procurement: a percent delta Hosted vs Dedicated for their baseline, and Private lead time estimate. Please see my suggested numbers below (we'll formalize in the MAP update):

- Baseline: 3TB tokens/mo, 10M embedding units/mo.
- Hosted (eu): baseline pricing estimate = $0.18 / 1k tokens equivalent + $0.003 / embedding unit (region-premium applied).
- Dedicated (reserved, monthly commit): approximately 30–40% discount vs Hosted at their volumes depending on commit and model family.
- Private (on-prem / VPC): setup fee typically $35k–$60k + 6–8 week lead time for infra + networking + compliance attestation; ongoing unit costs roughly comparable to Dedicated once provisioned.

Questions:
1) Can we tighten the Dedicated discount range to 30% flat at signing for a predictable procurement number?
2) Do we have any EU-hosted case studies that specifically call out <48hr failover SLA (they asked about uptime SLOs)?

I'd like to push back a short MAP update to NovaHealth by end of week with numbers and a revised timeline.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@novahealth.co.uk>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 10:02:00 +0100
Subject: RE: NovaHealth evaluation — MAP kickoff and constraints

Emma — thanks for the patience. Per Vanessa's note, attached is an updated MAP that includes: 1) a Dedicated pricing slab with a flat 30% discount vs Hosted for your baseline, 2) a Hosted fallback plan (eu region) with explicit telemetry retention options, 3) an SLA_proposal_v2.docx summarizing availability and failover behaviors.

Key bullets:
- Pricing: Dedicated (reserved) = 30% off Hosted for signed 12-month commit; Hosted billed monthly with region premium; Private requires setup fee (est. $45k) and 6–8 week lead time.
- Timeline we recommend:
  - 2026-03-01 — finalize MAP and pilot scope
  - 2026-03-08 — start pilot (2 weeks perf + integration)
  - 2026-03-22 — procurement review meeting (NovaHealth)
  - 2026-03-29 — target contract signature (we can accelerate if PO in hand)

- Security artifacts: SOC2 report + audit log export will be provided; I've linked the evidence in the MAP's related links.

Action: Please confirm which deployment mode you'd like to pilot (Hosted-eu or Dedicated-reserved). If Dedicated, we'll prepare a contract addendum and PO guidance.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: SLA_proposal_v2.docx

Subject: RE: NovaHealth evaluation — MAP kickoff and constraints (Decision)

Vanessa / Rishi — After our internal risk & procurement meeting, NovaHealth will proceed with a Dedicated-reserved pilot in eu-west as the initial deployment mode. Rationale: predictable throughput & clearer SLA alignment with our clinical workloads.

Next steps from NovaHealth side:
- Legal will issue a PO once Redwood sends the contract addendum (please include the 30% Dedicated discount as proposed).
- We expect to start the pilot week of 2026-03-08; procurement review is on 2026-03-22 and we'll aim to have the contract signed by 2026-03-29.

Please share the contract / DocuSign link and a one-page PO guidance doc so our Procurement team can proceed. Also include the SOC2 package and the audit log export instructions in the DocuSign packet.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Emma Clarke
Head of Digital Transformation, NovaHealth
emma.clarke@novahealth.co.uk
